flags.reason: The source says "always", but the stated reason is stale (in the installed build title and body default to empty and the button renders only with buttonLabel or onPressButton), and inline-compact never renders a title while stacked-detailed ignores the body and button, so "all three" cannot apply to every type. Read as recommended, not hardened into a constraint.
The guide gives no avoidWhen guidance; left empty rather than guessed.

examples.purpose: A split-payment suggestion on a payment screen, in a lavender appearance; the screen handles the button and removes the nudge on close.
examples.jsx:
<Nudge
  title="Split payment"
  body="Pay ₹12,000 in 3 monthly instalments."
  buttonLabel="See plans"
  onPressButton={() => {}}
  onClose={() => {}}
  modes={{ 'Color Mode': 'Light', Context: 'Nudge&Alert', AppearanceBrand: 'Secondary' }}
/>

examples.purpose: Stacked detailed: a title over list items, with no button or close.

<Nudge type="stacked-detailed" title="Why split this payment?" modes={{ 'Color Mode': 'Light', Context: 'Nudge&Alert' }}>

  <ListItem layout="Horizontal" title="Three monthly payments" supportText="₹4,000 on the 5th of each month" modes={{ 'Color Mode': 'Light', Context: 'Nudge&Alert' }} />
</Nudge>

props.name: type
props.description: Controls the layout type. - "stacked-prominent": icon + title/body/button content - "inline-compact": icon + body/button in one row - "stacked-detailed": header + children detail slot. Default "stacked-prominent", from the component source.

props.name: title
props.description: Names the card: on the web the root is a region named by its title. Declared: Title text displayed in the nudge. Empty when omitted. Default "", from the component source.

props.name: body
props.description: Body text displayed in prominent and compact types when no children are provided. Empty when omitted. Default "", from the component source.

props.name: buttonLabel
props.description: Label for the default button. The default button renders only when this or `onPressButton` is set. `buttonSlot={null}` removes it.

props.name: onPressButton
props.description: Callback for the default button press. Also opts into the default button.

props.name: buttonSlot
props.description: Custom button slot. `null` or `false` removes the button. Omit to use `buttonLabel` / `onPressButton` when one of those is set.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Only reports the press; the screen removes the nudge. Declared: Callback fired when the default close IconButton is pressed. Does not control visibility — use `showClose` (or `closeSlot`) for that.

props.name: showClose
props.description: Show the trailing close button on `stacked-prominent` and `inline-compact`. Defaults to `true`. `stacked-detailed` never renders it. `onClose` does not control visibility.

props.name: closeSlot
props.description: Replaces the default close, an IconButton ic_close labelled “Close” with forced Neutral / Low / S modes. Declared: Custom close slot, overrides the default close IconButton.

props.name: startSlot
props.description: The default sparkle icon is hidden from assistive tech. Declared: Optional leading slot. Omit for the token-driven sparkle icon, pass null/false to hide.

props.name: children
props.description: Replaces the title, body and button in stacked-prominent; the body and button in inline-compact; the list in stacked-detailed. Declared: Content slot — overrides default content, or provides detailed list content.

props.name: modes
props.description: Slot children get the Nudge's modes. Declared: Mode configuration for design token resolution.

modes.name: AppearanceBrand
modes.description: A token collection Nudge reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

gaps.text: In Color Mode Dark the title stays #1e1a14 on a dark card, about 1.1:1 and effectively invisible (#208).
No appearance mode reproduces Figma's white card with a purple icon.
inline-compact never renders title, and stacked-detailed ignores body, the button props and the close props.
The default close button's name, “Close”, cannot be overridden.
Nothing is announced and focus is not managed when a nudge is removed.
